# Georgia 5 Star Plumbing

> Licensed and insured North Georgia plumbing company owned and operated by Master Plumber Jiv Jelev, with over 25 years of experience.

Canonical site: https://ga5starplumbing.com/
Phone: +1-404-488-4889
Email: georgia5starplumbing@gmail.com
Online booking: https://ga5starplumbing.com/book

## Services

- Emergency plumbing and leak repair
- Drain cleaning and sewer or drain pipe replacement
- Water heater repair and installation, including tankless and hybrid
- Bathroom plumbing and remodel plumbing
- Gas and water piping
- Light commercial plumbing
- Leak detection, water filters and garbage disposals
